long_description: Praan is a venture-backed deep-tech climate company. It develops patent-pending filterless technology that captures particulates and carbon dioxide from ambient air. It sells air purification hardware, including the Sanctuary product shown at DesignPOV 2026, to commercial and industrial customers and to architects and developers. It was founded in 2017 by Angad Daryani and has dual headquarters in San Francisco and Mumbai. Reported funding totals are roughly $1.6M–$2M, and sources differ on the exact figure.
industries: Air Purification; CleanTech; Climate Tech; Hardware; IoT

long_description: Peptilogics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that designs and develops novel peptide therapeutics. Through their computational platform, Peptilogics is radically altering drug discovery by not only uncovering new, previously unexplored chemical design space, but ensuring that each potential therapeutic is biologically viable and scalable to manufacture. Peptilogics' lead clinical stage peptide therapeutic, PLG0206, is a novel, broad-spectrum anti-infective that has been granted FDA Orphan Drug Designation and Qualified Infectious Disease Product Designation for its initial focus on the treatment of prosthetic joint infections, an unmet medical need.
